scenes.say: This pizza costs one dollar. This one costs one million dollars. And today, Chip is eating both.
Every pizza costs ten times more than the last, and he has to rate every single one.
We start with the one dollar slice. It's cold. It's burnt. And honestly, it's kind of crunchy in a bad way.
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: Ten dollars gets you a real cheese pizza. Not bad. Chip gives it a five.
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: At one hundred dollars, it's handmade, wood fired, and covered in toppings.
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: One thousand dollars! Imported cheese, a chef flown in from Italy, and it's the size of a car tire.
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: Ten thousand dollars. This one is covered in truffles, and it actually sparkles. But wait, there's still one more.
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: This is the one million dollar pizza. Twenty four karat gold leaf, the rarest cheese on Earth, and a crust baked for seven days straight!
scenes.label: PIZZA

scenes.say: So here's the real question. Which one tastes better? The answer might surprise you.

scenes.label: ...OR TAKE THE CASH?
scenes.say: Chip can keep eating, or skip the pizza and take one million dollars instead.

scenes.headline: HE TOOK THE CASH!
scenes.name: CHIP
scenes.say: He took the cash! And then he spent ten dollars on the cheese pizza. Smart.
Which pizza would you pick? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for the one million dollar burger.
